mapper.select: SELECT restaurant_course_idx AS restaurantCourseIdx, restaurant_course_name AS restaurantCourseName, restaurant_course_image AS restaurantCourseImage, restaurant_course_info AS restaurantCourseInfo, admin_idx AS adminIdx, restaurant_sale_yn AS restaurantCourseSaleYN FROM "RESTAURANT_COURSE" WHERE restaurant_sale_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY restaurant_course_idx
